entities.summary: Fatemeh Haghighatjoo is an Iranian scholar and reformist politician who represented Tehran, Rey, Shemiranat and Eslamshahr in the Iranian Parliament from 2000 to 2004. She left Iran in 2005 and resides in the United States, where is the CEO and co-founder of the 501(c)(3) organization Nonviolent Initiative for Democracy (NID).
